nodes.name: heroui.css
nodes.summary: HeroUI v3 stylesheet scoped exclusively to the signed-in (/dashboard, /admin) route group: imports @heroui/styles/css, declares light-dark() theme tokens implementing the Mobbin design spec (.claude/skills/DESIGN-mobbin.md) under [data-wicloud-app], and pins HeroUI's --primary/--secondary/--default/--muted/--danger variables so the dashboard's contrast requirements hold. Imported only by app/(app)/layout.tsx so the marketing pages never download it.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS light-dark() with a data-theme attribute driving color-scheme, avoiding a client-side flash-of-unstyled-theme; @source directives are needed because the Tailwind entry lives in node_modules via @heroui/styles/css.

nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Root layout for the signed-in app route group ((app)): a deliberately thin pass-through that imports heroui.css and sets noindex/nofollow metadata, leaving actual navigation/guards/data to each dashboard's own AppShell.
nodes.languageNotes: Importing heroui.css here rather than in the document root layout is what keeps the marketing site's CSS bundle from including HeroUI's non-JIT-purged component styles.

nodes.name: AppLayout
nodes.summary: Default-exported layout component for the (app) route group that simply renders its children, delegating all real shell/navigation work to the dashboard- and admin-specific AppShell components.
